title: Phantom Blade Zero Physical Edition - Is There a Disc?
description: Short answer: no. Phantom Blade Zero launches October 29, 2026 as a digital-only game on PS5 and PC. No boxed edition, steelbook or retailer disc has been announced, and one retailer already pulled its listing.
keyword: phantom blade zero physical, phantom blade zero disc, phantom blade steelbook, phantom blade zero physical copy, phantom blade zero gamestop

facts.label: PC
facts.value: Steam and Epic Games Store, digital

sections.title: The Short Answer
sections.content:
There is no physical version of Phantom Blade Zero at launch. The game releases on 29 October 2026 as a digital purchase on PlayStation 5, Steam and the Epic Games Store. No boxed PS5 edition, no steelbook, and no retail disc has been announced by S-GAME or its publisher.

If you were waiting for a disc, the practical consequence is that you need roughly 135 GB of free space on the console and a working download on day one, because there is no disc to install from while a patch downloads.

sections.title: What happened at Play-Asia
sections.content:
Play-Asia, a retailer that commonly stocks Asian imports, had listed a physical edition of Phantom Blade Zero. That listing has since been removed, with the situation reported as the retailer being told a physical version would not be available. Until S-GAME says otherwise, treat any store page claiming a boxed copy as stale or a third-party placeholder.

It is worth being precise about what this does and does not mean: it is not a statement that a disc will never exist. It is that none is coming for launch, and no later physical run has been announced.

sections.title: If you want to collect something
sections.content:
The Digital Deluxe Edition is the only premium tier, and it is worth being clear about what it is: the two extra outfits (Wulin Legend and Blood-Steel Form), a digital artbook and the digital soundtrack. There is no physical goods bundle, no map, no statue and no steelbook attached to any edition.

Both editions also carry the pre-order unlocks - the Treasure Basin accessory and the Legacy outfit - and S-GAME's own store copy states that pre-order content can be obtained through playing. The two Deluxe outfits are labelled exclusive, which is a separate question the official page does not settle.

A note on what this page leaves out. The Chinese and Japanese store pages list these bonus items under localised names, but this page does not reproduce them: no second source has confirmed the exact character forms we would print, and inventing or half-remembering a product name is how incorrect names spread across this niche. The English names above are the ones recorded against the official product page and the Steam listing on 2026-10-16, and they are logged with that date on the news page.

sections.title: Why this question keeps coming up
sections.content:
Comment-volume analysis around the trailer coverage put roughly a third of the week's discussion on the missing disc, heavily concentrated in Spanish-language communities, in the form of "no disc, no buy". That is a real segment of the audience, not a rounding error, and it is the reason this page exists rather than being buried in an FAQ.

The related searches tell the same story: "physical", "physical release", "physical copy", "ps5 physical copy" and "steelbook" all appear among the rising queries for the game, alongside retailer names. Every one of them is asking the same question, and the answer is no.

sections.title: What Is Still Unknown
sections.content:
• Whether a physical edition will ever appear. No announcement either way. Some publishers run boxed releases months later if a game sells well; there is no evidence S-GAME has planned that.
  • Whether a collector's edition exists. Reports of a collector's edition selling out quickly came from the Chinese market, which is a different distribution situation from the West.
  • Day-one patch size. The 134.857 GB figure is from the store listing before any launch update, so the real day-one requirement is unknown.
